AURA modifications:
- React 19 component with ordinary div attributes; existing layout is retained.
- Edge-only rounded-rectangle normal map, capped at 160,000 pixels / 640 pixels per axis.
- No WebGL, external assets, package dependencies, pointer capture or continuous animation.
- Recompute map only for a measured size or radius change, with a single coalesced timer.
- Pause size observation and scheduled work while the document/surface is hidden.
- Clean up observers, timers and media-query/document listeners on unmount.
- Keep foreground text/inputs sharp through backdrop-filter, never a foreground filter.
- Frosted/solid fallback for unsupported filters and accessibility preferences.

The upstream demos, artwork, screenshots and project UI are not bundled.
